title: I used AI to completely digitize my local bakery
description:
I can’t believe I just built this…

I used AI to completely digitize my local bakery.

They have the best croissants, but their lines are out of control.

So I built them a complete software stack using @emergentlabs 

Customers can now see this live menu that shows all of their daily items and exactly how many are left….

You can pay ahead, reserve your croissants, and skip the line entirely.

But honestly, the crazier part is the back end software I made for the bakery itself.

The bakers can add items and quantities as they make them, live track inventory, and re-order ingredients from suppliers all in the same dashboard.

They also have a live queue for all pick up pre-orders, and can even get new recipe recommendations based on the latest demand.

Now this is an entire software stack custom built for this bakery…

And the craziest part is…I have no idea how to code.

All I did was give one paragraph to Emergent about my goals for helping to automate the bakery, and it built all of this custom software in just a few hours.

Now if you’re a business owner, in basically any industry, this should be the light bulb moment for you.

Until now, it was incredibly hard to figure out how to customize technology for a small business.

There are off the shelf tools, of course, but most businesses are duck taped together under the hood.

Well that has now completely changed…

Because we have officially entered the custom software era for businesses.

1 of 1, perfectly designed software tools for you, ready to use in just a few minutes.

Now the reason this custom software era is possible is because of tools like Emergent.

And if you’re using this to get ahead, you’re going to be very hard to compete with as a business owner.

Think of Emergent like a software factory that can build tools for you automatically.

It’s running all the latest models, and they make it super easy to go from 0 to 95% done with your initial prompt.

From there, you can iterate, with natural language, and then push the tools live, so you can actually use them in your business.
